text: when students die during a school-sponsored team-building activity, responsibility typically falls on the organizing coaches/school staff, the school administration, and potentially the resort operators for failing to exercise proper diligence and safety protocols. the people responsible for the team building activity should answer these questions: - was there a formal and robust pre-activity risk assessment conducted to identify all potential risks that may cause harm to participating students? this is very basic and if this was not done, it is already a good starting point to build a case involving school negligence. - for the risks identified, what mitigation measures were to taken to eliminate or minimize the risk? - are there weather contigencies and equipment inspections conducted prior to the team-building? - are there comprehensive health screenings performed to determine if the students are fit for the activities scheduled? - are students allowed to opt out of specific physical activites without penalties if they feel unsafe? - were safety briefings done at the start of the team building activity? - what is the ratio of the supervising staff to students? text: magkaiba yung negligent homicide sa reckless imprudence resulting to homicide: a.) negligent homicide - more on passive ito. meaning yung inaction or lack of caution resulted to someone's death. common sa parent/guardian na napabayaan ang anak. b.) reckless imprudence resulting to homicide - resulta ng action. for example nagmamaneho or nagooperate ng machine, pero naka aksidente dahil hindi listo o maingat ang nagooperate.
evidence: magkaiba yung negligent homicide sa reckless imprudence resulting to homicide: a.) negligent homicide - more on passive ito. meaning yung inaction or lack of caution resulted to someone's death. common sa parent/guardian na napabayaan ang anak. b.) reckless imprudence resulting to homicide - resulta ng action. for example nagmamaneho or nagooperate ng machine, pero naka aksidente dahil hindi listo o maingat ang nagooperate.
evidence_en: The difference between negligent homicide and reckless imprudence resulting in homicide: a.) negligent homicide - more passive. Meaning, inaction or lack of caution resulted in someone's death. Common in parents/guardians who neglected their child. b.) reckless imprudence resulting in homicide - a result of action. For example, driving or operating a machine, but an accident occurred because the operator was not ready or careful.
